name: Probucol

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States, first in 1995 — for effects on the body's chemistry and heart harm

summary: Probucol was pulled from the market in the United States starting in 1995 due to concerns over heart harm and metabolic harm, which refers to problems with how the body processes energy [3]. According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a low score of 27 for liver risk [M]. This same computer model also calculated a low score of 14 for heart risk [M].
